# Audit log

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/audit`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/audit.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/events` | Newest first. |  | 200 `AuditPage` |
| `GET` | `/v1/verify` | Recompute the tenant's whole chain from genesis. |  | 200 `Verification` |
